en: "But... there is no need... to remember it."
"What's this guy babbling about?{n} What can he do all by himself?{n} Or is he just off his head!?"
"But doesn't something about it{n} bother you?"
"I hear the soldiers of the Assyrian{n} army are all tough, mighty meeen."
"Would a soldier from an army like{n} that really pick a fight he had no{n} chance of winning from the staaart...?"
"Like I said. He's off his head."
"Please be careful, Mr. {hero:6}.{n} That man's eyes... those are the eyes{n} of a man certain of victory."
"No, he does not appear to be alone.{n} I detect multiple moving objects. Troops{n} appear to be lying in ambush somewhere."
"The fierce fighting ki that man's{n} body gives off... Never before have{n} I felt a ki so tremendous..."
"I'll say it... one last time...{n} ...Get away from here... quickly.{n} You can never... beat that man..."
"Even in the Assyrian army... he's{n} ...one of the top five. An immortal...{n} the strongest of warriors..."
"I too... once, during army drills...{n} ...saw the way he fights... just once{n} ...with my own eyes..."
"Alone... he wiped out... a tank{n} division... and what's more...{n} without moving... a single step..."
"Without moving? Then how{n} does he fiiight?"
"Yes... I will send you... to paradise."
"He had the Voids hidden under{n} the ground ahead of tiiime!?"
"Heh! He's off his head after all!{n} As if one man could control{n} this many Voids all by himself!"
"No way!? I don't believe it!?{n} All these Voids, and he's working{n} them like his own arms and legs!?"
"To me... Voids are...{n} ...a part of my own body. I can{n} control them... with my eyes closed..."
"N-No, of course nooot!? I can't die{n} in a place like this, with my{n} promise to Hector still unkept!"
"Even if you ask me that, at this rate{n} the Voids are going to kill us{n} for suuure!?"
"Everyone, please take up your weapons!{n} Beating the Voids is our only way{n} to seize a chance at winniiing!"
"The enemy controls a mass of Voids!{n} We counter with Voids of our own!{n} It's all-out war! Got it!?"
"Put our Voids out in front too!{n} Voids against Voids! It looks{n} like the only way we haaave!"
"So... it came to a fight after all...{n} ...It can't be helped... even if{n} this place... becomes my grave..."
"Abandon the woman... who saved my{n} life... and run off alone...?{n} ...That... I cannot do..."
"So let us survive together. That is{n} the best way to repay {name:6},{n} to whom we owe our lives."
"But... it is only a matter of time..."
"Tch! What tough Voids!?{n} Can Voids really be raised{n} to be this strong!?"
"We managed to take one dooown!{n} Keep it up, everyone! Now straight{n} for the enemy Master!"
"Lt. {hero:6}! We're counting on you,{n} sir! Your precise orders are all{n} we have left to rely on!"
"God is watching from heaven even now!{n} If we keep trying and do not give up,{n} He will surely lend us His strength!"
"Heh, if there really is a God, I'd{n} like that strength right about now!"
"Still, the enemy's no slouch either!{n} To handle so many Voids{n} this splendidly!"
"A true master of Void handling!{n} If I could, I'd love to take him{n} apart and study that brain of his!"
"Hang in there, Prince {hero:6}!{n} Whining like that{n} isn't like my prince at aaall!"
"Do your best, everyone, if you please!{n} Li'l Tethys is doing her best too!"
"C'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon!{n} What're you scared of, {hero:6}!?{n} So what if he's a Void Master!"
"You've got the great Parsifal with{n} you, the one you can always{n} count on, don't you!? Huh!?"
"Press on... {name:6}...{n} ...No matter what comes... I will{n} protect you..."
"Tch! There's no end to this!{n} Go for the Void Master! Hit him{n} with special moves or magic!"
"Even if we beat the Voids, we only{n} wear ourselves out in the eeend!"
"At this point, beating the enemy{n} leader, the Void Master, is the{n} only option we have leeeft!"
"But... there is no need... to remember it."
"Good grief, that was a rough fight."
"Farewell... Juggernaut...{n} ...As a warrior... of the same land...{n} I am proud of you..."
"Phew, this battle really was{n} exhausting, wasn't iiit?"
"It's been bugging me for a long time.{n} That thing where you draaag out the{n} ends of your words. What's it for?"
"Oh dear, oh dear, what a bind I'm iiin!?"
"That. Right there.{n} That 'bind I'm iiin' thing."
"This is embarrassing to saaay, but{n} it's the dialect of the Isle of Ifish,{n} where I was born and raaaised."
"But Aerial doesn't draaag things out{n} like you do. She was born on{n} the same island too, right?"
"Yes, I am from the same island."
"Weeell... it's juuust... a simple...{n} generation gaaap...{n} thaaat is... how to put iiit..."
"Hah! I see, I get it. So old hags{n} like you use a lot of dialect,{n} is that it!?"
"That is right, Mr. {hero:6}!{n} Lady {name:6}{n} is not an old hag!"
"What's the harm?{n} An old hag's an old hag."
"No! An old lady,{n} at the very most!"
"Waaah, 'old hag' and 'old lady'{n} are both meeean, I think!"
"Ahh, all right, all right, I get it."
"No... I was an idiot for asking."
"To think it was... such a stupid reason."
"Anyway, tomorrow it's back to hunting{n} for rings. Let's check our gear, log{n} our records and turn in early today..."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
